agent_executions_launch_expiry_check.name: agent_executions_launch_expiry_check
agent_executions_launch_expiry_check.value:
"agent_executions"."launch_intent_expired_at" is null or
        ("agent_executions"."launch_intent" is null and "agent_executions"."used_temporary_credentials" is not null)

github_installation_syncs_settlement_che.name: github_installation_syncs_settlement_check
github_installation_syncs_settlement_che.value:
("github_installation_syncs"."settled_at" is null and "github_installation_syncs"."audit_link" is null and "github_installation_syncs"."payload_expired_at" is null)
        or ("github_installation_syncs"."kind" = 'webhook' and "github_installation_syncs"."settled_at" is not null
            and "github_installation_syncs"."retry_at" is null and "github_installation_syncs"."audit_link" is not null)

github_installation_syncs_evidence_check.name: github_installation_syncs_evidence_check
github_installation_syncs_evidence_check.value:
(
    "github_installation_syncs"."kind" = 'webhook' AND "github_installation_syncs"."provider_application_id" IS NOT NULL AND "github_installation_syncs"."delivery_id" IS NOT NULL AND "github_installation_syncs"."signature_hash" IS NOT NULL
    AND "github_installation_syncs"."source" IS NOT NULL AND "github_installation_syncs"."source" IN ('github.installation', 'github.installation_repositories') AND "github_installation_syncs"."payload" IS NOT NULL
  ) OR (
    "github_installation_syncs"."kind" = 'reconcile' AND "github_installation_syncs"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL AND "github_installation_syncs"."delivery_id" IS NULL
    AND "github_installation_syncs"."signature_hash" IS NULL AND "github_installation_syncs"."source" IS NULL AND "github_installation_syncs"."payload" IS NULL
  )

instance_bootstrap_completion_check.name: instance_bootstrap_completion_check
instance_bootstrap_completion_check.value: "instance_bootstrap"."completed_at" is null or ("instance_bootstrap"."organization_id" is not null and "instance_bootstrap"."owner_user_id" is not null)

interactive_session_commands_body_check.name: interactive_session_commands_body_check
interactive_session_commands_body_check.value:
octet_length("interactive_session_commands"."body") <= 16384 and
      ("interactive_session_commands"."kind" <> 'message' or "interactive_session_commands"."body" is not null or "interactive_session_commands"."body_expired_at" is not null) and
      ("interactive_session_commands"."body_expired_at" is null or "interactive_session_commands"."body" is null)

interactive_session_profiles_cwd_check.name: interactive_session_profiles_cwd_check
interactive_session_profiles_cwd_check.value:
octet_length("interactive_session_profiles"."cwd") <= 1024 and (
      left("interactive_session_profiles"."cwd", 1) = '/' or left("interactive_session_profiles"."cwd", 2) = repeat(chr(92), 2)
      or (left("interactive_session_profiles"."cwd", 2) ~ '^[A-Za-z]:$' and substr("interactive_session_profiles"."cwd", 3, 1) in ('/', chr(92))))

interactive_session_profiles_worktree_ch.name: interactive_session_profiles_worktree_check
interactive_session_profiles_worktree_ch.value:
"interactive_session_profiles"."worktree" is null or (
      jsonb_typeof("interactive_session_profiles"."worktree") = 'object' and
      "interactive_session_profiles"."worktree" @> '{"mode":"branch-off"}'::jsonb and
      "interactive_session_profiles"."worktree" - 'mode' - 'base' = '{}'::jsonb and
      (not ("interactive_session_profiles"."worktree" ? 'base') or jsonb_typeof("interactive_session_profiles"."worktree"->'base') = 'string'))

interactive_session_profiles_access_chec.name: interactive_session_profiles_access_check
interactive_session_profiles_access_chec.value:
"interactive_session_profiles"."provider" <> 'omp' or
      ("interactive_session_profiles"."mode" is not null and ("interactive_session_profiles"."mode" <> 'full' or "interactive_session_profiles"."full_access_acknowledged"))

organization_api_keys_webhook_auth_check.name: organization_api_keys_webhook_auth_check
organization_api_keys_webhook_auth_check.value:
(
        "organization_api_keys"."webhook_auth_mode" is null and "organization_api_keys"."webhook_signature_profile" is null
        and "organization_api_keys"."webhook_target_trigger_id" is null
      ) or (
        "organization_api_keys"."webhook_auth_mode" is not null and "organization_api_keys"."webhook_auth_mode" = 'hmac'
        and "organization_api_keys"."webhook_signature_profile" is not null
        and "organization_api_keys"."webhook_signature_profile" = 'github_sha256'
        and "organization_api_keys"."webhook_target_trigger_id" is not null and "organization_api_keys"."actor" is not null
        and "organization_api_keys"."scopes" = ARRAY['events:send']::text[]
        and "organization_api_keys"."allowed_triggers" is not null and cardinality("organization_api_keys"."allowed_triggers") = 1
        and coalesce("organization_api_keys"."allowed_triggers"[1] ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$', false)
      )

organization_connection_attempts_shape_c.name: organization_connection_attempts_shape_check
organization_connection_attempts_shape_c.value:
("organization_connection_attempts"."phase" = 'github_setup' and "organization_connection_attempts"."provider" = 'github' and "organization_connection_attempts"."candidate_external_id" is null and "organization_connection_attempts"."pkce_verifier" is null)
        or ("organization_connection_attempts"."phase" = 'github_user_authorization' and "organization_connection_attempts"."provider" = 'github' and "organization_connection_attempts"."candidate_external_id" is not null and ("organization_connection_attempts"."pkce_verifier" is not null or "organization_connection_attempts"."consumed_at" is not null))
        or ("organization_connection_attempts"."phase" = 'discord_authorization' and "organization_connection_attempts"."provider" = 'discord' and "organization_connection_attempts"."candidate_external_id" is null and "organization_connection_attempts"."pkce_verifier" is null)
        or ("organization_connection_attempts"."phase" = 'slack_authorization' and "organization_connection_attempts"."provider" = 'slack' and "organization_connection_attempts"."candidate_external_id" is null and "organization_connection_attempts"."pkce_verifier" is null)
        or ("organization_connection_attempts"."phase" = 'linear_authorization' and "organization_connection_attempts"."provider" = 'linear' and "organization_connection_attempts"."candidate_external_id" is null and "organization_connection_attempts"."pkce_verifier" is null)

organization_webhook_secrets_slot_check.name: organization_webhook_secrets_slot_check
organization_webhook_secrets_slot_check.value:
("organization_webhook_secrets"."slot" = 'current' and "organization_webhook_secrets"."accept_until" is null)
        or ("organization_webhook_secrets"."slot" = 'previous' and "organization_webhook_secrets"."accept_until" is not null)

project_configuration_sources_authority_.name: project_configuration_sources_authority_shape_check
project_configuration_sources_authority_.value: ("project_configuration_sources"."kind" = 'manual' and "project_configuration_sources"."github_connection_id" is null and "project_configuration_sources"."github_repository_id" is null and not "project_configuration_sources"."automatic_deployment_enabled") or ("project_configuration_sources"."kind" = 'github' and "project_configuration_sources"."github_connection_id" is not null and "project_configuration_sources"."github_repository_id" is not null)

projects_archive_shape_check.name: projects_archive_shape_check
projects_archive_shape_check.value: ("projects"."status" = 'active' and "projects"."archived_at" is null) or ("projects"."status" = 'archived' and "projects"."archived_at" is not null and "projects"."active_configuration_revision_id" is null)

provider_event_receipts_payload_expiry_c.name: provider_event_receipts_payload_expiry_check
provider_event_receipts_payload_expiry_c.value:
("provider_event_receipts"."payload_expiry_state" is null and "provider_event_receipts"."payload_expired_at" is null)
        or ("provider_event_receipts"."payload_expiry_state" is not null and "provider_event_receipts"."payload_expiry_state" in ('expiring', 'expired')
            and "provider_event_receipts"."payload_expired_at" is not null)

provider_event_receipts_pre_routing_drop.name: provider_event_receipts_pre_routing_drop_check
provider_event_receipts_pre_routing_drop.value:
"provider_event_receipts"."pre_routing_drop" is null or ("provider_event_receipts"."pre_routing_drop" in ('no_project_route', 'no_trigger_for_source', 'configuration_unavailable')
        and "provider_event_receipts"."pre_routing_drop" is not distinct from "provider_event_receipts"."dropped_reason" and "provider_event_receipts"."accepted_routes" is null)

run_reply_deliveries_state_check.name: run_reply_deliveries_state_check
run_reply_deliveries_state_check.value:
("run_reply_deliveries"."state" in ('pending', 'sending', 'sent') and "run_reply_deliveries"."failure" is null)
          or ("run_reply_deliveries"."state" = 'refused' and "run_reply_deliveries"."failure" is not null)

run_reply_deliveries_attempt_check.name: run_reply_deliveries_attempt_check
run_reply_deliveries_attempt_check.value:
("run_reply_deliveries"."attempted_at" is null and "run_reply_deliveries"."state" in ('pending','refused')
              and "run_reply_deliveries"."length" is null and "run_reply_deliveries"."content_hash" is null and "run_reply_deliveries"."binding_hash" is null)
          or ("run_reply_deliveries"."attempted_at" is not null and "run_reply_deliveries"."state" in ('sending','sent','refused')
              and "run_reply_deliveries"."length" is not null and "run_reply_deliveries"."length" between 1 and 3500
              and "run_reply_deliveries"."content_hash" is not null and "run_reply_deliveries"."binding_hash" is not null)

run_timeline_events_data_check.name: run_timeline_events_data_check
run_timeline_events_data_check.value: octet_length("run_timeline_events"."data"::text) <= case when "run_timeline_events"."kind" = 'truncated' then 128 when "run_timeline_events"."kind" in ('step_finished', 'run_finished') then 512 else 1024 end

run_timeline_state_budget_check.name: run_timeline_state_budget_check
run_timeline_state_budget_check.value: "run_timeline_state"."event_count" between 0 and 5102 and "run_timeline_state"."byte_count" between 0 and 196608 and "run_timeline_state"."step_end_count" between 0 and 100 and "run_timeline_state"."step_end_bytes" between 0 and 51200 and "run_timeline_state"."dropped_count" >= 0 and "run_timeline_state"."step_rows_omitted" >= 0

trigger_runs_payload_expiry_check.name: trigger_runs_payload_expiry_check
trigger_runs_payload_expiry_check.value:
("trigger_runs"."payload_expiry_state" is null and "trigger_runs"."payload_expired_at" is null and "trigger_runs"."payload_summary" is null)
        or ("trigger_runs"."payload_expiry_state" is not null and "trigger_runs"."payload_expiry_state" in ('expiring', 'expired')
            and "trigger_runs"."payload_expired_at" is not null and "trigger_runs"."payload_summary" is not null)

trigger_runs_outcome_check.name: trigger_runs_outcome_check
trigger_runs_outcome_check.value:
("trigger_runs"."outcome" = 'accepted' and "trigger_runs"."status" <> 'rejected' and "trigger_runs"."rejection" is null)
        or ("trigger_runs"."outcome" = 'rejected' and "trigger_runs"."status" = 'rejected' and "trigger_runs"."rejection" is not null)

trigger_runs_deadline_shape_check.name: trigger_runs_deadline_shape_check
trigger_runs_deadline_shape_check.value:
("trigger_runs"."outcome" = 'accepted' and "trigger_runs"."deadline_at" is not null)
        or ("trigger_runs"."outcome" = 'rejected' and "trigger_runs"."deadline_at" is null)
